title: Measles Returned With 2,289 US Cases
closing: Losing elimination puts a preventable infection back within reach of every classroom.
question: Did you know measles was eliminated?

segments.say: US measles cases reached 2,289, reversing the tiny totals seen when elimination was declared.
Unvaccinated people made up 93% of cases, showing where the outbreak found room to spread.
One Texas outbreak produced 702 cases, proving a concentrated gap can drive a national comeback.
